title: Wunderkind Config
description: Schema for Wunderkind global and project configuration files.

region.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global region default.

industry.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global industry default.

primaryRegulation.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global primary regulation default.

secondaryRegulation.description: Optional project-level override for the inherited global secondary regulation default.

cavemanEnabled.description: Enable project-default caveman mode for terse, high-signal replies when value is preserved.

promptOptimizationEnabled.description: Enable the separate supplementary prompt optimization engine. The product-default posture is off, so omit the promptOptimization* keys entirely unless you are intentionally opting in. This never changes the audit-only token-audit contract or surface. Unsupported features remain unsupported: no persistent cross-session memory writes and no automatic context injection. When enabled, the security-safe baseline stays on: redacted reporting, preserve/fallback enforcement, and no protected-content persistence drift.

promptOptimizationMode.description: Runtime optimization mode for the separate supplementary engine: off keeps the default-off posture, advisory measures/report budgets, and active allows bounded trimming of supported sections only without changing the audit-only token-audit surface. Unsupported features remain unsupported: no persistent cross-session memory writes and no automatic context injection.

promptOptimizationLevel.description: Capability-based surface selector for the separate supplementary prompt optimization engine. Levels are cumulative and remain outside the audit-only token-audit surface. Legacy enabled repos that omit promptOptimizationLevel stay on the current shipped behavior until an operator explicitly chooses one of the supported levels. Unsupported features remain unsupported: no persistent cross-session memory writes and no automatic context injection.

promptOptimizationReportingMode.description: Opt-in runtime reporting posture for the separate runtime-report surface. persist and summary keep sanitized/redacted latest-report artifacts or summaries under .wunderkind/runtime/prompt-optimization/ without changing the audit-only token-audit surface. This reporting surface stays within the same default-off engine contract and does not add persistent cross-session memory writes or automatic context injection.

promptOptimizationTokenBudget.description: Optional token budget used only when the current model matches the supported exact OpenAI map and the separate default-off prompt optimization engine has been intentionally enabled.

promptOptimizationByteBudget.description: Optional byte-budget fallback for unsupported or unset models when operators intentionally enable the separate default-off prompt optimization engine and still want bounded runtime behavior.
